top_story_title: Cisco BroadWorks XXE flaw (CVE-2026-20320) added to CISA KEV with confirmed exploitation
top_story_summary: CISA added CVE-2026-20320 in Cisco BroadWorks to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-11-10, citing evidence of active exploitation. The flaw is an improper restriction of XML external entity reference that, per CISA, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information from an affected system. Reported CVSS score is 7.5. The same KEV batch added CVE-2026-111793 in Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder, which is not network-device software. The federal remediation due date for both is 2026-11-24.
top_actions: Inventory BroadWorks deployments and check each against the fixed-release table in the Cisco advisory for CVE-2026-20320; the news coverage does not state a fixed build and must not be used as the upgrade target.
Treat any internet-reachable BroadWorks XML/OCI interface as exposed: put an ACL or reverse proxy in front of it and restrict to known provisioning and management sources until patched.

Assume configuration disclosure has already happened on exposed systems - rotate service-account passwords, API credentials, SIP/trunk secrets and any database credentials stored in BroadWorks configuration after upgrading.
Review web and application logs for XML payloads containing DOCTYPE/ENTITY declarations or outbound requests to external systems triggered by request parsing.
Separately close CVE-2026-111497: apply the Cisco Node.js/Brotli advisory fixes - its KEV due date of 2026-11-10 has already passed.
executive_summary: CISA confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-20320 in Cisco BroadWorks (XXE, unauthenticated configuration disclosure, CVSS 7.5); KEV due date is 2026-11-24.

Cisco's October Node.js roundup carries KEV-listed CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, potential RCE) whose due date of 2026-11-10 has already passed, plus two TLS hostname validation bypasses.

Citrix and Ivanti both patched critical and high-severity flaws allowing certificate tampering, remote code execution and host compromise - the reporting names neither products nor fixed builds, so go to the vendor advisories.
Recently patched Barracuda vulnerabilities are being exploited for authorization bypass and root access; verify your appliances actually took the fix.
Fortinet released nearly 100 fixes in one cycle after adding frontier AI models to its product security testing - expect larger, faster vendor patch batches.
Cisco issued an emergency distrust notice for eight eMudhra intermediate CAs whose private keys are brute-forceable; audit trust stores on anything doing TLS inspection or cert-based auth.
Cisco ISE and ISE-PIC have authorization-bypass bugs in the web management interface with no workaround - software update only.
key_actions: **Cisco** — Identify BroadWorks instances from asset inventory and compare running versions against the fixed-release table in the Cisco advisory - do not take a version number from news coverage.
**Cisco** — Restrict the XML/provisioning and management interfaces to known management sources with an ACL or upstream proxy; remove any internet exposure.
**Cisco** — Read the Cisco advisory's affected-product table and match it against your inventory; products absent from the list are stated by Cisco to be unaffected.
**Cisco** — Prioritise CVE-2026-111497 - it is KEV-listed and its 2026-11-10 due date has already passed.
**Multiple** — Open the current Citrix and Ivanti security bulletins directly and build the affected-product and fixed-build list from them rather than from news coverage.
**Multiple** — Patch to the vendor's fixed build and run the vendor Integrity Checker Tool where one is offered.
**Fortinet** — Pull the current Fortinet PSIRT advisory list, filter it by the models and versions you actually run, and sort by whether the affected interface is internet-reachable.
**Fortinet** — Confirm the running version against Fortinet's fixed-release table and schedule the upgrade inside the change window, HA pair secondary first.

headlines.title: Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave Flaws Actively Exploited Despite Available Patches
headlines.summary: CISA added Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 to the KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation; the XXE flaw lets unauthenticated attackers read configuration data.

headlines.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
headlines.summary: Cisco's October Node.js roundup covers a KEV-listed Brotli decoder flaw plus two TLS hostname validation bypasses in Cisco products that embed Node.js.

headlines.title: Citrix, Ivanti Patch Critical and High-Severity Vulnerabilities
headlines.summary: Citrix and Ivanti shipped critical and high-severity fixes for flaws allowing certificate tampering, remote code execution and host compromise.

headlines.title: Fortinet Patches Nearly 100 Vulnerabilities
headlines.summary: Fortinet released close to 100 vulnerability fixes in one cycle, a volume the vendor attributes to adding frontier AI models to its product security testing.

headlines.title: Recently Patched Barracuda Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
headlines.summary: Barracuda flaws patched recently are now being exploited, with attackers able to bypass authorization and obtain root on affected appliances.

headlines.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
headlines.summary: Cisco issued an emergency distrust notice for eight eMudhra intermediate CAs whose private keys can be brute-forced in seconds after a flawed 2025 key ceremony.
